items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ed Garth. [INTERVIEWEE] Paul Foster? I know Foster good. [INTERVIEWER] You're not talking about Foster. Ed Garth. No, he's not big. [INTERVIEWEE] No, this was a...

ctx.x: Wasn't Bill Johnson. No, wasn't Bill. He was your... Wellman Brog?
Paul Foster? I know Foster good.
